# ReadPixelFast

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Buffers and Pixels](BlitzBasic-Buffers-and-Pixels)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ReadPixelFast:Int32 x:Int32, y:Int32, buffer:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int32 | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | Int32 | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |
| `buffer` | Int32 | `0` | The locked buffer to read from. Defaults to the current buffer. |

**Returns:** The color of the pixel, or 0 if the position is outside of the buffer.

## Description

Returns the color of a pixel of a locked buffer in the same form as [ReadPixel](ReadPixel). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer).

## Differences

* A buffer that is not locked stops the program with an error message. In the original a position outside of the buffer reads other memory.
* The buffers that [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) makes with a depth above 32 are read as they are stored: with the depth 30 the number is A2R10G10B10, and with 64 it is ARGB with the upper 8 bits of each channel. [ReadPixelFast64](ReadPixelFast64) gives all of them. See [Color depth](Color-Depth).
